components.html:

components.css: .ds-dream{font-family:var(--font, "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans Thai", sans-serif);background:#0c162cf5;color:var(--ink,#f2f5ff);border:1px solid #31476a;border-radius:14px;padding:20px 22px 17px;min-height:160px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;}.ds-dream>svg{color:#94c5ff;margin-bottom:12px;}.ds-dream p{font-family:"Noto Sans Thai",var(--font,sans-serif);font-size:clamp(20px,1.55vw,27px);line-height:1.65;font-weight:500;margin:0 0 18px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.ds-dream>span{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#adbfdf;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;}.ds-dream b{font-size:10px;font-weight:400;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}

components.name: Arrival Panel
components.description: Featured readable dream segment with a gentle entrance.
components.html:
ความฝันดวงใหม่เดินทางมาถึงแล้ว

[ข้อความความฝัน]

อีกหนึ่งความฝัน อีกหนึ่งจุดเริ่มต้น
components.css: .ds-arrival{font-family:var(--font, "Manrope Variable", "Noto Sans Thai", sans-serif);margin:0 0 20px;padding:24px 30px;background:#132d51;color:var(--ink,#f2f5ff);border:1px solid #6192c9;border-radius:16px;animation:ds-arrive 700ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both;}.ds-arrival>div{color:#b6e6ff;font-size:13px;}.ds-arrival p{font-family:"Noto Sans Thai",var(--font,sans-serif);font-size:clamp(25px,2.7vw,44px);line-height:1.65;font-weight:500;text-align:center;margin:17px auto;max-width:1000px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;white-space:pre-wrap;}.ds-arrival>span{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;font-size:10px;color:#b6d1f0;}@keyframes ds-arrive{from{opacity:.65;transform:translateY(12px);filter:blur(3px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);filter:blur(0);}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-arrival{animation:none;}}

narrative.overview:
An anonymous dream becomes a star in a shared Neptune sky. Deep blue space, real Neptune photography, fine orbits and ice-white Thai text support the exact event theme: “Beyond the Star. Dream Begin.”

The public wall is a spacious projector experience; administration is a denser operating surface. Opaque message panels keep the sky behind the reading plane. CSS in app/globals.css remains the implementation authority.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight blue with cyan and electric blue accents.
Thai-first message readability with compact Manrope controls.
A single featured arrival, then a rotating shared wall.

rules.name: The Reading Plane Rule
rules.body: Preserve full Thai text on the opaque message plane; long submissions advance through readable segments rather than shrinking into microtype.

dos: Do preserve the supplied event wording and Neptune identity.
Do keep Thai dreams on opaque, high-contrast surfaces and retain every segment.
Do preserve keyboard focus, pause/resume and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't invent institutional logos, endorsements or participant dreams.
Don't turn the public wall into a submission form or CLI tutorial.
